response.content:
## Companies Launched in Finland in 2026

There is no single comprehensive registry of every company launched in Finland during 2026, but here are the key highlights from available sources:

### Ecosystem Overview
- Finnish startups raised **$1.9 billion** in venture capital in the year to 23 September 2026. The Finnish startup scene in 2026 has been described as producing a **€10B decacorn, two new unicorns, and a quantum IPO**.
- The number of new startups in Finland returned to growth: **331 new startups** were identified in 2024 (up ~28% from 258 in 2023), and the trend has continued strengthening into 2025–2026.

### Notable New Companies and Launches in 2026
- **Talli** — A Nordic drive-up self-storage platform established in 2026 through a partnership between US real estate investment firm Heitman and Finnish company Talliosake. Talli launched with 15 properties (11 in Finland) and aims to build thousands of rental storage and commercial spaces in Finland and Sweden.
- **Playables AI** — A Helsinki-based company that evolved from Quicksave Interactive, pivoting its business direction into a new venture focused on AI-driven playable content.
- **Cosmic Lounge** — A Helsinki-based mobile gaming studio co-founded by Tommi Kiviniemi, Tomi Huttula, Mika Karkinen, and Peter Tokoi.
- **ELLIS Institute Finland** — Officially launched in 2026 as a new AI research institute, bringing together top AI researchers and connecting with the startup ecosystem.
- **LUMI AI Factory Hub** — Opened in Finland in 2026, providing innovation and AI expertise.
- **Adwello** — A branding agency launched in 2025/2026 and based in Helsinki.

### Key Events Supporting New Launches
- **Slush 2026** (November 18–19, Helsinki) continues to be a major launchpad for Finnish startups, bringing together founders, investors, and ecosystem players from around the world.
- **Business Finland** reported that the startup ecosystem is strengthening, with startups investing heavily in R&D and generating new high-value-added business and exports.

This is not an exhaustive list, as hundreds of new companies are registered in Finland each year. For a complete registry, Finland's Patent and Registration Office (PRH) maintains official records of all new business registrations.

# Finland’s startup ecosystem strengthens as the number of new startups returns to growth

Release 13.11.2026

The number of identified startups in Finland returned to growth in 2024 after several years of decline. A total of 331 new startups were identified, compared with 258 in 2023, representing an increase of approximately 28%. [...] A startup is a young, innovative company aiming for international growth, whose business model and market are often still developing. Startups differ from other new companies particularly in their focus on scalable business models and their need for external funding.

The turnaround is encouraging, although the number of startups has declined over the longer term. In 2016, 587 startups were identified.

Identified startups by year of establishment

Startups that received funding from Business Finland or angel investment from FiBAN, or participated in Slush (2014–2026), by year of establishment. The number of startups established in 2025 in particular will be updated as more companies are identified and newly established companies receive funding or participate in Slush. [...] ## Startups renew Finland’s economy and exports

“The increase in the number of new startups is an encouraging sign. Startups typically invest heavily in research and development, generating new high-value-added business and exports. That is exactly what Finland needs,” says Marjo Ilmari, Senior Director at Business Finland.

## Summary

 Heitman acquired a majority stake in Talliosake’s rental operating business and established Talli, with Talliosake retaining a minority stake and its current management team leading the platform.
 Talli launches with 15 properties, 11 in Finland, and aims to develop thousands of rental storage and commercial spaces in Finland and Sweden.
 The analyst sees Talli’s expansion as a potential competitive threat to Cityvarasto, though their offerings currently differ. Talliosake units start at 19 m², while Cityvarasto’s average 4.3 m².
 According to the analyst, international investor interest supports sector valuations and Cityvarasto’s M&A option. Any sale depends on founder Ville Stenroos, who owns around 47%, being willing to sell.

Slush 2026 takes place on November 18–19, 2026 in Helsinki, Finland.

Slush 2026 is one of the world’s leading startup and technology events, bringing together startups, founders, investors and ecosystem players from around the world. With a strong focus on entrepreneurship, innovation and investment, the event provides a platform for building connections, exchanging ideas and exploring opportunities to support the growth of innovative companies.

Nefco will be present at Investor Day on 17 November, as well as during the Slush 2026 main event on 18–19 November.
